title: NIST IR 8323r1 Foundational PNT Profile

source.title: Foundational PNT Profile: Applying the Cybersecurity Framework for the Responsible Use of PNT Services
source.checked: As recorded by the open engine's mapping: Profile tables 3 to 25 read for the subcategories cited; identifiers follow the Profile's tables (Cybersecurity Framework 1.1).

duties.duty: Inventory the systems that depend on PNT and assess the risk of losing or corrupting PNT data.
duties.gap: Asset inventory and risk acceptance are the organisation's own.

duties.duty: Protect PNT data integrity and plan for diverse sources and holdover.
duties.gap: Physical antenna protection and network security controls are not assessed.

duties.duty: Detect anomalous PNT data and monitor sources continuously.
duties.gap: Detection performance holds only in the scope of each product's pre-registered bars.

duties.duty: Analyse PNT incidents and communicate them.
duties.gap: Response plans and communication duties are the organisation's own.

duties.duty: Recover PNT-dependent services and record lessons learned.
duties.gap: Recovery execution is the organisation's own.

wording: Each duty below is mapped to the Kshana evidence products whose signed output can be put before the operator's assessor for it, and lists what Kshana does not provide. The pack is an aid for preparing an audit. It does not state, and must not be read as stating, that any system or operator meets the framework; that judgement belongs to the operator, its assessor and its authority.
